_doc: Documented statuses no //go:build integration test asserts through the real handler against PostgreSQL, each with its reason. Read by api/integration_coverage_test.go, which fails on an empty reason, an unknown operation or status, and an exemption a covers: marker already satisfies. Add an entry only when the status cannot be caused through the handler against a real database; otherwise write the test.
